profile.headline: CAE Software Developer
profile.summary: Experienced Software Engineer with a demonstrated history of working in the computer software industry. Skilled in CAA, OpenGL, .NET Framework, Modeling, and C#. Strong engineering professional with a M.S focused in Mechanical Engineering , Computer Aided Engineering; CAE) Concentration from Colorado State University.

positions.title: Software Developer
positions.description:
3D Solid Modeling Kernel, Development, Application Development, 
C++ Development. 3D Modeling Kernel. Libraries are delivered to costumer, which use it for developing CAD, CAM, CAE applications.
Job duties include coding new functionality, bug fixing and general c++ issues related to the software development cycle in this company.
Skills used are generally Object Oriented Programming, logic for solid modeling topology generation and handling, provide solutions in the form of geometric representations (e.g. curves, surfaces, b-splines) , iterative computational numerical methods, develop component libraries for C# applications.
Applications commonly used : C++ in Microsoft Development Studio, QT, Unix development tools (ddd, gdb, dbx),  Rational Rose Purify
Projects:
Quality, Services, Development: Implementation of API journaling mechanism for rapid defect report.
Component: Implementation of new functionality for solid model editing features such as handling of sheets when it was limited to closed models before, open body extensions.
Services: Collaboration with costumers for initial implementation of our libraries in their application.
Documentation: internal documentation project, translating old documentation into wiki-based documentation using scripts and administrative tasks on the website.
Culture: Collaboration on pilot project aimed to implement Agile culture in company, along with other work tools such as XP.
Product: C#, development of application framework based on .NET to provide start point of CAD/CAE application, highly componentized, along with an automatic integration process, (build, testing, packaging)
Product: C++/C# interfaces, developed manual and automatic wrapping of C++ libraries into .NET assemblies, using CLI programming and or SWIG.

positions.title: ME/CAD Lab Instructor and Teaching Assistant
positions.description:
Provided instruction to mechanical engineering students on software tools used in their engineering classes.
Jobs duties included teaching of CAD applications such as IronCAD, SolidWorks, Computational applications such as  MathLab, MathCAD and basic engineering applications of spread sheets and databases.

positions.title: Manufacturing/Process Engineer
positions.description:
Assisted and verify manufacturing process of Printed Circuit Boards from chip installation and soldering to tool design for manual manufacturing steps.
Other tasks involved teaching and documenting of new instruments or equipment, with Spanish to English translation and liason with the spanish counterparts.

positions.title: Research Assistant
positions.description:
Provided 3D modeling and analysis of industrial parts requested by automotive and metal/mechanic industry in Mexico.
Jobs duties included performing Finite Element Modeling and  Analysis (FEM/FEA); Discretization and Meshing of solid models; Distribute  analysis loads through the local area network (LAN) computers;  Construct rapid model prototyping using Stereolithography; CAD Instructor:
Development of manuals and classes for AutoCAD customers; Programmer for pre and post processing data for in house analysis tools, interacting with the CAE applications.
Applications commonly used : AutoCAD, ProE, CATIA, NASTRAN, PATRAN, I-DEAS,  Unix, C++.
